negativeGuards.effect: A timestamp is not a salt merely because both are bitstrings.
Multiple frames do not imply multiple fingerprints if only one aggregate hash is generated.
Salt caching is blocked when freshness, randomness, or nonce uniqueness is required.
One GOP can equal all obtained data only when the obtained-data scope is itself limited to that GOP or block.
Unlocated quotations receive a source-audit flag and may only use verified structural evidence.
